fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-04-21, the complainant noticed that Rs. 12,00,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval. The time of the incident was given as 17:40 on 2026-04-20. Geetha Kumari approached Vellore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000202. Logesh Karuppasamy (mobile 9000000198) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Pavithra Bai, reachable on 9000000006, was mentioned in the complaint. The account reference SYN-ACC-100060 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. The complainant mentioned a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, witness, witness statement, main street, evening, suspect, bank account
